description: The public meetings that decide things on the islands — Kiawah Island Town Council, Seabrook Island Town Council, Charleston City Council and Charleston County Council: every date the body itself has posted, with the time, the place, the agenda once it posts, and each body's stated schedule and agendas page. Dates are never worked out from a pattern; a body that posts none (the County) gives its schedule and its meetings site instead.

body.description: kiawah-council = Kiawah Island Town Council; kiawah-planning = Kiawah Island Planning Commission; kiawah-bza = Kiawah Island Board of Zoning Appeals; seabrook-council = Seabrook Island Town Council; city-council = Charleston City Council; county-council = Charleston County Council
